fusions.name: Bosun's Nine Cords
fusions.desc: A lash that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Culling Pounce
fusions.desc: A pounce on a target at or below 30% health that deals 18 damage, uses up every affliction on it and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage. For 3 seconds after, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Righted Midfall
fusions.desc: Moves you 3 tiles from where you stood. For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Lucky Mouser Aboard
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
